request.description: Sets the authenticated user to no longer receive paper statements. Does not affect whether the user can view statements within Digital Banking. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs?
